claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM, quisinostat (JNJ-26481585) acts as a pan-HDAC inhibitor whose antiproliferative/killing effect is driven by histone and non-histone (alpha-tubulin) hyperacetylation, mitochondrial injury, ROS generation, and p53 up-acetylation, producing broad but somewhat selective cytotoxicity across cancer lines.
